instruction.text: Find all the nouns with possessive apostrophes in the text below.

hint.text:
Possessive apostrophes show who or what owns something.

For example:
the snail’s shell
the teachers’ books
hint.a: ssml: Possessive apostrophes show who or what owns something. For example:<break time='500ms'/> the snail’s shell.<break time='500ms'/> the teachers’ books.
